_readme: How to ENTER a named state, per character. Keyed by GCSIM key (our character id
with the underscores removed); the six Travelers are handled by name in the audit.
⚓ This table is deliberately SMALL, because the corpus already says what gates
each ability. `audit-gcsim-frames.mjs` reads every ability's own `conditions` and
derives the prerequisite from them: a `chainStage` at index N is N repeats of that
ability, and a `state` condition is one lookup here. So the only per-character
knowledge that cannot be derived is the single question 'what puts this character
into that state', which is exactly what this file answers.
Every row was PROPOSED by probing skill / hold-skill / burst / pairs of them, and
CONFIRMED by scoring the result against the FrameMaps the corpus already authors
for that character's gated abilities. A row is only here when the prereq scores
strictly better than no prereq at all; `_scored` records both numbers.
⚓ An EMPTY step list is a ROW, not an absence, and it says something: 'this state
does not change the frames — read them off the base capture.' Hu Tao, Wriothesley,
Xiao, Yoimiya and Durin's dark form are all like that, and Arataki Itto scores
strictly WORSE with a prereq than without one. ⛔ Leaving them out instead would
file them as UNCOVERED, which is a different and untrue claim.
`aim` (2026-09-17) is the one row kind that is NOT a state: which of our named
`chargeHits` entries gcsim's `A` (default hold) and `hA` (hold 1 = AimParamLv1,
the fully-charged shot for most bows) describe, for a bow whose DEFAULT aimed
shot is kit-specific. gcsim-map.mjs otherwise reads A != hA as 'hA is the partial
draw', which is Ganyu and Sethos and is wrong for these.

_unresolved.chasca: Multitarget Fire (Tap): 0/1 under every candidate prereq. gcsim's base attack (34/13) and its post-skill reading (39/39) both disagree with the authored 11f. Adjudicate before migrating any Chasca normal.
_unresolved.kinich: Loop Shot / Scalespiker Cannon: gcsim errors on `skill` under every prereq we tried, so the Nightsoul skill is never captured at all.
_unresolved.lanyan: Feathermoon Ring (N / E): 0/2 under every candidate.
_unresolved.varesa: Fiery Passion Strikes: her skill leaves her AIRBORNE, so a post-skill `attack` reads a plunge-adjacent animation rather than her Nightsoul normal. Needs a landing step the driver vocabulary does not have.

aratakiitto.note: Raging Oni King. ⚓ An EMPTY prereq is a positive statement: the probe scored base 2/4 and every candidate prereq 1/4, so entering the stance makes the reading WORSE. Read it off the base.

cyno.note: Pactsworn Pathclearer — five normals against the base's four.

durin.note: ⚠️ transmuting = E (the Purity recast window). darkForm = E then N: inside the skill window gcsim's Attack() IS the Denial of Darkness recast, which sets denial-of-darkness — the status Burst() branches on (burst.go:48). ↻ 2026-10-04 (ICD cap round follow-up): darkForm was an EMPTY row on the strength of identical FRAMES, which made its APPLICATION capture the WHITE burst — the audit read the Dragon of White Flame under the dark Q.

hutao.note: Paramita Papilio. ↻ 2026-09-17: the prerequisite was empty on the belief that the stance frames equal the base; they do not (ppChargeFrames 42 vs 62, N6 hit 27 vs 23), and the empty driver manufactured four false rows.
hutao._scored: skill — reproduces the authored Paramita maps exactly

lauma.note: Spiritcall Prayer. gcsim's `deerStateReady` starts true, so a bare `C` is the DEER (the base map, non-hitting); the Prayer needs the deer entered and then ENDED — any action but walk/jump ends it — after which `C` is the attack for 4s. ⚠️ The ender is a BURST, not an attack: an `attack` step advances gcsim's normal counter, so the sibling's N1/N2/N3 captures came back rotated by one (3 false rows). The burst leaves no summon ticking and touches no counter. The surviving `hit 73→67` row is the audit's cancel-tier inference, not gcsim's `chargeHitmark` (73) — read it, don't migrate it.
lauma._scored: charge+burst 4/5 (charge+attack 1/5 — the attack rotates the combo; base: uncovered — a bare C is the deer)

lyney.note: Aimed shots. Default hold is AimParamLv2 = the Prop Arrow; hold 1 is the fully-charged shot.

mavuika.note: Flamestrider. ⚠️ Her BURST scores the same 5/5 — it also opens the ring — but hold-E is the cast the corpus models, so that is the row.

mualani.note: Sharky's Bite. ⚓ Its 215f swap looked like a mis-authored full sequence and is not — gcsim reproduces it exactly once the skill has run.

nilou.note: Pirouette / Whirling Steps. ↻ 2026-10-04: `stacks.danceStep` is what one step of the shared dance counter costs — one more press — so Whirling Steps 2 and 3 are captured behind 2 and 3 presses instead of all three reading step 1.

odette.note: Coda at Dawn's Tolling. gcsim has no separate entry point: a second Skill() inside the 394f recast window (`useSpecialSkill`) IS the Coda, and the dumper bypasses cooldowns, so the prereq is one skill cast.
odette._scored: skill 1/1 (base: uncovered — no gcsl spelling for the sibling)

skirk.note: Seven-Phase Flash. ⚓ SKILL, not burst — the burst reading was the near-miss that made this look unresolvable.

wriothesley.note: Chilling Penalty — frames identical to the base reading.

xiao.note: Yaksha's Mask — frames identical to the base reading.

yelan.note: Aimed shots. gcsim starts Yelan with the Breakthrough Barb READY, and any hold-1 aim fires it. `A` reads the Barb; `hA` must spend it first (`before`), or it reads the Barb too. ↻ 2026-10-04: the capture ORDER used to spend it (pass A shared one core, `A` before `hA`); a fresh core per capture made that explicit.

yoimiya.note: Niwabi Enshou — frames identical to the base reading.

zibai.note: Lunar Phase Shift. ⚠️ An in-mode `skill` is Spirit Steed's Stride, which gcsim gates on 70 Phase Shift Radiance in ActionReady — the dumper calls Skill() directly, so the gate is bypassed and the capture reads the Stride.
zibai._scored: skill 6/6 (base 5/6 — the Stride reads the opening cast)
